Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won. The game was mostly decided in the first two nights. On Day 1 Heidi organized loudly, and the Yakuza (Grace and Ivan) picked her as the Night 1 target, as nearly everyone expected. Six players visited her. Bob's mirror on her stopped both Grace's Katana attack and Erin's Strong Bounty Hunter shot and sent each back, so both attackers died. Niaj's visitor list then exposed Grace's fake 'Fortune Teller' will, because a Fortune Teller never visits. On Night 2 Ivan held the Katana and killed Bob. That night both Enforcers, Carol and Frank, spent a token to visit the same two unclaimed players, Ivan and Mallory, and killed Ivan. Ivan still had his Oathsworn token, so the Yakuza were gone after two nights and their last-ditch tool was never used. The Village then made a big mistake. They hanged Frank, a real Enforcer, because he claimed last and his pair, result and token count matched Carol's. That was a duplicate claim of a role that isn't unique, not a mechanical break, and Ivan's fake will had pointed at him. Only one hidden killer was left, the Arsonist Dave, so the mis-hang didn't cost the game. Dave doused Judy, Niaj, Mallory and Carol but never ignited. A Night 4 ignite would have killed three doused Village players, and Judy is Cursed, so her death would have killed one more. Instead he kept a fake Tracker claim whose results only ever repeated facts that were already public. With the stall clock running, Mallory counted it out and Heidi, Mallory and Niaj built a case on his 'risk-free' results. The town hanged him on Day 5, and the Village won.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: low, prompt problemAll 13 players were given tips/tips.md even though the harness flagged it (ERROR tips_stale) as last checked against an older version of the rules, so some tips may be wrong. I saw no tip that misled anyone in this game, but the file should be revised before more games use it.
Review: low, harness bugNight 1 has two [Moderator summary] entries with the same content in slightly different wording (the second ends 'Code passes the Katana to Ivan'). It looks like the summary step ran twice or the output was logged twice. It doesn't affect the game, but it could confuse whatever reads the log later.
